name: [UPD] Throw Stuff at People
desc:
Throw stuff at people with a variety of items and don’t get hit yourself!

Chuck stuff at NPCs, fight bosses, explore the secrets of the map, and buy items to boost your throwing ability!

🌟Hit players with objects to earn points!
💰Use points to buy bigger and better objects!
💪Buy items to increase your throwing and knockback power!
🔍Explore the map and complete quests to unlock secret items!

UPDATE!!
NEW CURSED BRICK!
-A mythical and powerful item capable of destroying an enemy in one shot!
-Unlocked by throwing the brick 500 times!
NEW SPAWN PROTECTION!
-Makes you immune to hits for 5 seconds to finally prevent spawn camping!
NEW THROW BAR!
-Added a throw bar that displays the recharge cooldown on items!
UI FIXES!


Created by eeeeee2513 and bigeviper2 :)
